;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Yemeni Crisis (2011–present)]]
**[[Yemen]]-based [[Houthi movement|Houthi]] forces launch drone strikes on [[Jizan Regional Airport]] and [[Abha International Airport]] in [[Saudi Arabia]]. A [[Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen|Saudi Arabian-led coalition]] spokesperson says a Houthi drone has been shot down near the Saudi city of [[Abha]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-yemen-security-saudi-drone/yemens-houthis-target-two-saudi-airports-with-multiple-drone-attacks-idUSKCN1TG0M3 (Reuters)]
*12 [[Kenya|Kenyan]] police officers are killed when their vehicle hits a roadside bomb in east [[Wajir County]], near the [[Somalia|Somali]] border. No one has claimed responsibility, though the police had been pursuing suspected [[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|al-Shabab]] militants fighting Somalia's government and its backers. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-48648777 (BBC News)] [https://regionweek.com/kenya-12-police-officers-killed-in-attack-in-wajir-county-along-the-border-with-somalia/ (Region week)]
*Twin explosions rock [[Mogadishu]] killing 11 and injuring over 25. The first bomb went off near a [[Security checkpoint|checkpoint]] for the presidential palace killing nine and the other [[Car bomb|bomb]] killed the two occupants in the [[Vehicle|vehicle]]. [[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|Al Shabbab]] claimed responsibility. [https://time.com/5607825/11-killed-explosions-somalia-mogadishu/ (''Time'')] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/06/somalia-killed-al-shabab-attacks-mogadishu-190615165754730.html (Al Jazeera)]

;Arts and culture
*The [[Notre-Dame de Paris|Notre Dame Cathedral]] holds its first mass since the [[Notre-Dame de Paris fire|April 15 fire]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/notre-dame-cathedral-holds-mass-devastating-fire-attendees/story?id=63732602 (ABC News)]

;Disasters and accidents
*Seven people—four sanitation workers and three staff members—die after inhaling toxic fumes from a Darshsan Hotel sewer cleaning in the village of Fartikui in western [[India]]. The hotel owner is charged with the fatalities. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-48648769 (BBC News)]

;Health and environment
*The [[Ministry of Health (Peru)|Ministry of Health of Peru]] reports that so far this year, 548 people have contracted [[Guillain–Barré syndrome]] in an outbreak in the country. It also clarified that in the five cases in which patients died, death was caused by complications with other serious diseases. [https://peru21.pe/lima/aumentan-548-casos-sindrome-guillain-barre-peru-484598 (Perú.21)]

;International relations
*[[Japan–United States relations]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] thanks [[Prime Minister of Japan]] [[Shinzō Abe]] by phone for his effort to mediate between the U.S. and Iran. [https://www.therahnuma.com/trump-thanks-abe-for-efforts-to-ease-us-iran-tensions/ (''The Rahuma Daily'')]
*[[India–United States relations]]
**India announces that effective Sunday it will impose tariffs, some as high as 70 percent, on 28 United States products, including almonds and apples, in response to the [[Federal government of the United States|U.S. government's]] refusal to exempt [[Government of India|India]] from higher taxes on steel and aluminum imports. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-48650505 (BBC News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Hong Kong anti-extradition bill protests]]
**Hong Kong Chief Executive [[Carrie Lam]] announces that the government has suspended its [[Fugitive Offenders and Mutual Legal Assistance in Criminal Matters Legislation (Amendment) Bill 2019|plan to allow extraditions]] to [[Mainland China#In Hong Kong and Macau|mainland China]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-48645342 (BBC News)]
*[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] confirms he has been briefed on a spike of [[Unidentified flying object|UFO]] [[UFO sightings in the United States|sightings]] in [[Earth]]'s atmosphere by [[United States Navy]] pilots, saying "people are saying they're seeing UFOs. Do I believe it? Not particularly". The U.S. Navy recently updated its guidelines for how its pilots can report "unidentified aircraft". [https://abcnews.go.com/Politics/exclusive-trump-unidentified-flying-objects/story?id=63725191 (ABC News)] [https://eu.usatoday.com/story/news/politics/2019/06/15/trump-briefed-ufos-but-doesnt-particularly-believe-them/1465077001/ (''USA Today'')] [https://www.foxnews.com/politics/trump-says-he-was-briefed-navy-sightings-of-ufos-do-i-believe-it-not-particularly (Fox News)]
*[[Slovakia]] inaugurates [[Zuzana Čaputová]] as its first female elected [[President of Slovakia|President]]. [https://www.euronews.com/2019/06/15/zuzana-caputova-sworn-in-as-slovakia-s-first-female-president (Euronews)]
